items.title: UniAE-MoE: A Unified Audio Encoder via Mixture of Experts
items.summary: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) rely on effective audio encoders for multi-task performance. We introduce UniAE-MoE, a unified audio encoder designed to model cross-domain audio representations and achieve outstanding downstream understanding performance via a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture. Specifically, we explore mainstream audio encoders and integrate those from Qwen2-Audio and Audio-Flamingo 3, which demonstrate superior downstream capabilities. To facilitate effective model fusion, we improve our encoder using SwiGLU with shared experts to decouple encoder networks, and we further introduce a two-stage instruction-tuning strategy to better adapt the model to diverse downstream tasks. Moreover, we propose the task-specific data scaling (TSDS) technique to enhance \tool's understanding capabilities. On the XARES-LLM benchmark, UniAE-MoE attains a score of 0.802, achieving state-of-the-art performance. It also delivers top-tier performance in the official Interspeech 2026 Audio Encoder Capability Challenge, further demonstrating robust generalization across diverse audio tasks. Together, these results validate the effectiveness of \tool for unified audio understanding across speech, music, and general audio domains.

concepts.name: 共享专家混合 (Shared-Expert Mixture of Experts)
concepts.readable: 把多个已训好的音频编码器当成不同专家，用一个门控网络按输入挑选或加权混合它们的表征，并额外留一组「共享专家」对所有输入都生效，从而在一个编码器里同时用上多个上游模型的优势。
concepts.analogy: 像球队把几位专长不同的球探报告汇总，由总教练按对手风格决定听谁的；同时总有一位熟悉所有对手的通识教练，他的意见每场都算数。
concepts.analogyBreaksDown: 球探是先独立写好报告再汇总投票，而这里的专家本身就是网络里的层，门控与专家是端到端一起训练的；共享专家也不是「顾问意见」，而是恒定参与计算的网络分支。
concepts.mechanism: 用 SwiGLU 替换专家内部的普通 FFN，并加一组对所有 token 恒定激活的共享专家：共享专家承载跨域共性，路由专家承载领域特化，使融合时各编码器的表征不必挤在同一组参数里，从而达到摘要所说的「解耦编码器网络」。

concepts.name: 两阶段指令微调 (Two-Stage Instruction Tuning)
concepts.readable: 把指令微调拆成先后两个阶段来做，目的是让模型更好适配语音、音乐、通用音频等多样下游任务。摘要只说明了「分两阶段」和「为了适配多样任务」，每一阶段具体做什么并未说明。
concepts.analogy: 像先上新兵通用训练营，学会听懂各种口令，再进专业兵种集训，针对具体岗位练专项技能。
concepts.analogyBreaksDown: 军队训练的阶段与考核是人定的且边界清晰；本文两阶段的具体划分、各阶段数据配比摘要都没给，而且微调的目标是拟合任务分布，并不存在一个明确的「结业考核」。
concepts.mechanism: 关键设计是把「适配下游任务」从一步微调拆成两个连续阶段，以缓解多任务一起调时的相互干扰；通常第一段偏通用指令对齐、第二段偏任务特化，但摘要未确认这一分工，需看原文。

concepts.name: 任务特定数据缩放 (Task-Specific Data Scaling, TSDS)
concepts.readable: 一种在训练数据侧做「按任务调整」的技术：针对不同下游任务改变其训练数据的配比或规模，让模型在不擅长的任务上获得更多训练信号，从而提升 UniAE-MoE 的理解能力。
concepts.analogy: 像备赛复习时按各科薄弱程度重排时间：弱科多刷题、强科少刷，用同样的总复习时间换更高的总分。
concepts.analogyBreaksDown: 复习时间是连续可调且效果立竿见影；TSDS 究竟缩放样本数量、采样权重还是别的维度，摘要没有交代，也不保证总数据量保持不变。
concepts.mechanism: 摘要只给出两点：它是任务特定（task-specific）的数据缩放技术，用来增强 UniAE-MoE 的理解能力。它作用在训练数据侧，与结构侧的 MoE 融合互补；准确的缩放维度与调度策略属摘要外信息。

formulas.name: 共享专家混合层与 SwiGLU 专家（Shared-Expert MoE Layer with SwiGLU Experts）
formulas.html: MoE(x) = x + Σ_s SwiGLU_s(x) + Σ_{i∈TopK(x)} g_i(x)·SwiGLU_i(x)，其中 g 只在选中的 top-k 上 softmax，SwiGLU(x)=W2(Swish(W1x)⊙W3x)
symbols: 该层输入表征（一个 token 的隐藏向量），shape 记为 [B, T, d]；摘要未给具体维度
共享专家数量，其输出对所有 token 恒定参与；摘要未给取值
由门控为 token x 选出的 top-k 路由专家集合
路由专家 i 的门控权重，只在 T(x) 内归一化，∑_{i∈T(x)} g_i(x) = 1
第 i 个专家前馈网络，内部为 W1/W3 双投影 + Swish 门控 + W2 输出投影
Sigmoid 函数，SwiGLU 中 Swish(z)=z·σ(z) 的门控因子
derivation: 动机：单一 FFN 难以同时承载多个上游音频编码器的异构表征，于是用多个专家并行替代单个 FFN。
稀疏路由：用 top-k 门控让每个 token 只激活少数路由专家，把参数量与计算量解耦。
补共享专家：全稀疏路由会把跨域共性也打散，于是加一组对所有 token 都激活的共享专家承载共性知识。
换成 SwiGLU：用门控线性单元增强单个专家的表达力，配合共享专家使各编码器表征更容易解耦。
残差相加：把输入 x、共享专家之和与加权路由专家之和相加，得到该层输出。
formulas.analogy: 像科室里既有几位「全科医生」对所有病人都接诊，又有专科医生由分诊台按病情叫号；SwiGLU 相当于每位医生先自己筛一遍信息再下结论，而不是把所有信息一股脑塞进一个判断。
pitfalls: 把共享专家也算进 top-k 路由竞争：共享专家不参与门控，恒定激活。
认为门控权重对「所有专家」求和为 1：实际只对选中的 top-k 归一化。
把 SwiGLU 当普通 ReLU-FFN：它有两个并行线性投影，其中一个过 Swish 后逐元素门控另一个。
把摘要里的「解耦编码器网络」理解为各编码器完全独立训练：摘要说的是融合时的结构设计。
formulas.code:
import torch, torch.nn as nn, torch.nn.functional as F

class SwiGLU(nn.Module):
    """SwiGLU 专家：W2(Swish(W1x) * W3x)"""
    def __init__(self, d, hidden):
        super().__init__()
        self.w1 = nn.Linear(d, hidden, bias=False)
        self.w3 = nn.Linear(d, hidden, bias=False)
        self.w2 = nn.Linear(hidden, d, bias=False)

    def forward(self, x):
        return self.w2(F.silu(self.w1(x)) * self.w3(x))

class SharedExpertMoE(nn.Module):
    """共享专家恒激活 + top-k 路由专家，相加后残差回加。"""
    def __init__(self, d, hidden, n_routed=4, n_shared=1, top_k=2):
        super().__init__()
        self.top_k = top_k
        self.router = nn.Linear(d, n_routed, bias=False)
        self.routed = nn.ModuleList([SwiGLU(d, hidden) for _ in range(n_routed)])
        self.shared = nn.ModuleList([SwiGLU(d, hidden) for _ in range(n_shared)])

    def forward(self, x):                      # x: [B, T, d]
        out = x
        for e in self.shared:                  # 共享专家：所有 token 都走
            out = out + e(x)
        logits = self.router(x)                # [B, T, n_routed]
        w, idx = logits.topk(self.top_k, dim=-1)
        w = w.softmax(dim=-1)                  # 只在选中的 top-k 上归一化
        for k in range(self.top_k):            # 逐 slot 聚合（工程上用 scatter/gather）
            wk = w[..., k:k + 1]               # [B, T, 1]
            ik = idx[..., k]                   # [B, T]
            for i, e in enumerate(self.routed):
                m = (ik == i).unsqueeze(-1).float()   # 命中第 i 个专家的 token
                out = out + m * wk * e(x)
        return out

moe = SharedExpertMoE(d=64, hidden=128)
print(moe(torch.randn(2, 5, 64)).shape)   # torch.Size([2, 5, 64])

items.title: Polymer informatics: A review of ai-driven structure-property modeling and material design
items.summary: Polymer science is undergoing a profound paradigm shift from labor-intensive, empirical trial-and-error experimentation to AI-guided, data-driven, and predictive material design. Owing to their multiscale structural diversity (spanning atomic connectivity, chain-packing behavior, and macroscopic morphology), polymer materials possess an enormous chemical design space that traditional experimental and computational methods cannot efficiently explore. High-precision quantum-chemical calculations are too computationally expensive for large-scale screening, whereas classical molecular dynamics simulations often involve trade-offs between force-field accuracy and accessible time scales. Against this backdrop, polymer informatics has emerged as a transformative interdisciplinary field that leverages artificial intelligence algorithms to mine structure–property–processing relationships from accumulated experimental, simulation, and literature data, enabling accurate property prediction and on-demand inverse design of polymer materials. This Review systematically summarizes recent advances in AI-guided informatics for polymer science based on an analysis of representative literature published between 2023 and 2025. The survey covers the current state of polymer informatics across four interconnected dimensions, organized around the logical backbone of data foundation, property prediction, inverse design, interpretability, and physical constraints. concepts.name: 结构-性质-加工关系建模
concepts.readable: 把聚合物的化学结构、链堆积方式和加工条件当成输入，用机器学习拟合出它们与最终材料性质之间的映射，再用这个映射去预测还没做出来的新聚合物会有什么性质。
concepts.analogy: 像做菜时看菜谱：食材搭配和火候决定味道，做多了就能从配料表大致猜出成品口味。
concepts.analogyBreaksDown: 菜谱一旦定下味道基本确定，而聚合物性质还强烈依赖分子量分布、链缠结与热历史，同一配方不同加工历史会给出不同结果。
concepts.mechanism: 先用描述符、指纹或序列/图表示把聚合物编码成向量，再在实验、模拟与文献数据上训练回归或图神经网络，学习结构-性质-加工映射，用于性质预测。
concepts.visual: 箱形图思路：左侧输入列[化学组成 / 链堆积 / 加工条件] → 中间方框[机器学习映射] → 右侧输出列[预测性质]，方框下方标注训练数据来源。

concepts.name: 逆向设计
concepts.readable: 不是先有材料再测性质，而是先写下想要的性质指标，再反过来搜索或生成满足这些指标的结构与配方。因为可能有很多种结构都能达到同一指标，所以这是一个一对多的搜索问题。
concepts.analogy: 像先定好想要的味道，再倒推该放哪些调料、各放多少，而不是先炒一盘再尝是什么味。
concepts.analogyBreaksDown: 调料总有可用的组合，而生成出的聚合物结构未必可合成、可加工，倒推出来的候选可能根本做不出来。
concepts.mechanism: 以性质预测模型当打分器，在生成模型、贝叶斯优化或变分自编码器等搜索策略下遍历设计空间，用预测性质逼近目标并加约束，迭代筛出候选结构。
concepts.visual: 箭头图思路：[目标性质向量] → [候选生成/搜索] → [性质预测打分] → 若未达标则回到生成步骤形成循环，外侧加一个[可合成性约束]的闸门标记。
prerequisites: 前向性质预测模型的训练与评估
生成模型或黑箱优化的基本概念

concepts.name: 物理约束与可解释性
concepts.readable: 纯数据驱动的模型可能给出违反物理规律或无法解释的预测，所以要让模型在预测时受物理规律约束，并让人能看懂它凭什么这么预测，这样才能被材料研究者信任和采纳。
concepts.analogy: 像天气预报模型说要同时出现零下气温和暴雨成灾，懂常识的人会立刻怀疑模型出错，物理约束就扮演这种常识审查。
concepts.analogyBreaksDown: 常识审查往往靠人主观判断，物理约束必须写成可计算的目标或结构，而很多聚合物的物理规律本身还没有公认的定量形式。
concepts.mechanism: 把物理规律以约束、损失项或结构先验的形式加入建模，并辅以可解释性分析，让预测同时满足数据一致性与物理合理性，并暴露模型依据。
concepts.visual: 双栏对比图思路：左栏[纯数据模型]下方列出可能给出的不合理预测，右栏[含物理约束模型]下方列出被约束拦下的同类预测，中间用一条竖向[物理规律]闸门分隔。

derivation: 先用实验、模拟与文献数据训练结构到性质的映射 f_θ，输入是描述符 D(x)。
正向使用：给定结构 x，预测性质 p̂，用于大规模虚拟筛选替代昂贵的量子化学计算。
逆向使用：把预测模型当成可微或可搜索的目标函数，在结构空间里最大化效用 U。
加入物理与可制造性约束 g_j(x) ≤ 0，避免搜到化学上不合理或无法合成的结构。
候选结构再回到实验或高精度模拟验证，形成「预测—设计—验证」闭环。
formulas.analogy: 像配一副合脚的鞋：先学会脚型到尺码的对应关系（正向预测），再反过来给定想要的舒适度去挑鞋型（逆向设计），最后还得受限于材料与工艺能不能做出来（约束）。
pitfalls: 正向预测精度高不代表逆向设计可用：优化器会主动钻到模型误差最大的区域。
摘要被截断，综述对表示方法差异与适用边界的结论未能读到，U 与 g_j 的具体形式属通用写法。
多目标性质之间常相互冲突，需要显式权衡而不是单一加权和。
缺少物理约束时容易生成无法合成或违反热力学规律的结构。
formulas.code:
import torch

def inverse_design(f_theta, encode, x0, steps=200, lr=0.05):
    """对连续松弛的结构表示做梯度上升, 最大化预测效用 U(f_theta(D(x)))."""
    x = x0.clone().requires_grad_(True)
    opt = torch.optim.Adam([x], lr=lr)
    for _ in range(steps):
        opt.zero_grad()
        p_hat = f_theta(encode(x))     # 正向: 结构 -> 性质
        loss = -p_hat.mean()           # 逆向: 最大化目标性质
        loss.backward()
        opt.step()
    return x.detach()

# 约束 g_j(x) <= 0 通常以惩罚项或投影的方式加进 loss/更新步骤

items.title: Fenchel Tilting: Weighted Correction for Efficient Finetuning of Generative Models
items.summary: Adapting a pretrained generative model to an arbitrary preference expressed as a utility function underlies reward alignment, guided design, and constraint satisfaction, enabling diverse applications. Existing fine-tuning methods trade off generality against computational cost: they either restrict the family class of supported preferences to keep optimization simple or preserve generality at the expense of efficiency. We introduce Fenchel Tilt Flow Control (FTFC), which decouples utility optimization from generative-model fitting. FTFC first optimizes for a target distribution by jointly fitting an effective reward and density-ratio weights on pretrained samples. Method combines the utility's variational structure with Fenchel duality, supporting general $f$-divergence penalties that determine how rewards are transformed into an distribution-correction weights. These weights are then frozen and used to modify a diffusion or flow model in a single stage of importance-weighted denoising or flow matching, without differentiating through sampling trajectories. We establish exact duality for concave utilities under suitable conditions and show that weighted fitting reproduces the optimal target distribution for a given utility. Across image and molecule generation benchmarks, FTFC improves over baselines on diverse preference functions, while also being up to $20\times$ more efficient. roposed method enables adaptation beyond expected-reward maximization without complex optimization, while preserving robustness for more general class of the utility functions compared to baselines.

existingEnrichment.tldr: 把效用优化与生成模型拟合解耦：先算冻结权重，再一次加权训练，快 20 倍。
keyPoints: 支持任意效用函数（不止期望奖励最大化）通常代价很高。

concepts.name: Fenchel 对偶与分布倾斜 Fenchel Duality and Distribution Tilting
concepts.readable: 把「对齐任意效用函数」和「拟合生成模型」解耦。第一步只在预训练样本上联合拟合一个有效奖励与密度比权重：用效用函数的变分结构与 Fenchel 对偶，支持一般 f-散度惩罚，由惩罚形式决定奖励如何被变换成分布修正权重。第二步把这些权重冻结，只用一次重要性加权的去噪或 flow matching 去修改扩散/flow 模型，完全不需要对采样轨迹求导。论文对凹效用函数给出精确对偶，并证明加权拟合能复现给定效用下的最优目标分布。
concepts.analogy: 不重新学做菜，只调整每种半成品的采购比例就能让最终菜单符合新口味；比例算一次就固定下来，做菜流程一个字不改。
concepts.visual: 分左右两段流程。左段：预训练样本点云 → 拟合奖励与权重（点的大小/颜色深浅表示权重）→ 一把锁表示「冻结」。右段：同一个扩散/flow 模型 + 冻结权重 → 一次重要性加权训练 → 目标分布点云。两段之间标注「不反向传播穿过采样轨迹」。

formulas.name: Fenchel 倾斜的分布修正权重 (Fenchel-Tilted Distribution-Correction Weights)
symbols: 预训练生成模型的采样分布
由效用函数经 Fenchel 对偶得到的有效奖励
温度/正则强度，由所选 f-散度惩罚的形式决定
冻结后用于重要性加权去噪/flow matching 的密度比权重
效用函数的 Fenchel 共轭，决定奖励如何映射为权重
derivation: 目标是把预训练生成模型适配到任意效用函数 u(x) 定义的目标分布，而不是只做期望奖励最大化。
直接在采样轨迹上做反向传播代价高；先把「优化效用」与「拟合生成模型」解耦。
用 Fenchel 对偶把「最大化效用 − f-散度惩罚」转成对偶问题，解出有效奖励 r 与密度比权重 w。
冻结 w，只用一次重要性加权的去噪/flow matching 拟合目标分布；对凹效用函数可证明该加权拟合复现最优目标分布。
formulas.analogy: 像调音台而不是重录：不重新演奏，只把各轨音量按一张一次算好的比例表调一遍，成品就换了风格；比例表算完就锁死。
pitfalls: 若只支持期望奖励最大化，就丢掉了约束满足、多样性等一般效用——Fenchel 形式的价值正在于覆盖更广的效用类。
λ 太小会让分布过度倾斜到奖励尖峰，生成多样性骤降；λ 太大则几乎不改变分布。
权重冻结后若继续更新模型却不重估权重，重要性加权会与当前模型失配。
formulas.code:
import torch


def fenchel_weights(reward, lam=1.0):
    """在预训练样本上算一次密度比权重，然后冻结（detach）。"""
    w = torch.exp(reward / lam)
    return w / w.mean()


# 一次重要性加权 flow matching：不对采样轨迹反传
loss = (w.detach() * ((v_theta(x_t, t) - v_target) ** 2).mean(dim=-1)).mean()

items.title: Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization
items.summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has improved the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), yet their predictions remain sensitive to task-irrelevant prompt features. We investigate this sensitivity through semifactual prompt interventions that preserve the underlying problem and its answer. Our analysis reveals substantial variation in token-level sensitivity and shows that suppressing high-drift token candidates during decoding improves reasoning accuracy without updating model weights. These findings highlight a limitation of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which assigns the same outcome-derived advantage to every response token and may reinforce potential spurious dependence alongside useful reasoning. Motivated by this observation, we introduce Semifactual Credit-Augmented Policy Optimization (SCAPO), a causally inspired variant of GRPO that incorporates semifactual stability into token-level credit assignment. SCAPO measures token probability drift for fixed responses under semifactual interventions and uses normalized stability scores to reduce advantages for relatively unstable tokens during early training, while granting no additional credit for stability alone. On Qwen3-4B-Base and Qwen3-1.7B-Base, SCAPO improves AIME 2024-2026 accuracy over GRPO by 5.63 and 4.17 percentage points, respectively. At both model scales, SCAPO achieves the best results on most evaluated mathematics benchmarks and all evaluated out-of-distribution benchmarks among the compared methods. These results suggest that semifactual stability provides an effective training signal for improving reasoning and generalization through finer-grained credit assignment in RLVR. The code is available at https://github.com/DtYXs/SCAPO.

existingEnrichment.tldr: 用半事实提示找出不稳定 token 并降低其优势，AIME 比 GRPO 高 5.63 分。
keyPoints: GRPO 把同一个答案级优势广播给每个 token，会强化虚假依赖。
半事实提示保持问题与答案不变，只改无关措辞。
测 token 概率漂移并归一化成稳定性，降权不稳定 token 的优势。
稳定本身不加分；Qwen3-4B 上 AIME 提升 5.63 分。

concepts.name: 半事实干预与 token 级信用分配 Semifactual Interventions and Token-Level Credit Assignment
concepts.readable: GRPO 把同一个答案级优势 A_i 发给回答里的每个 token。如果模型是靠题面里的无关特征（措辞、选项位置）答对的，这份虚假依赖也会被一起强化。SCAPO 构造「底层问题与答案不变、只改无关措辞」的半事实提示，测每个 token 的概率漂移；漂移大的 token 稳定性差，早期训练就降低它的优势，而稳定本身不额外加分。论文还发现：解码时直接抑制高漂移 token 候选就能提升准确率，且不需要更新权重。
concepts.analogy: 同一道菜换个盘子装。如果评委打分立刻变了，说明他在看盘子而不是在尝菜。SCAPO 找出这几口并压低它们的权重；但「换盘子也不变」并不额外加分，否则会鼓励对所有输入都麻木的答案。
concepts.visual: 横轴是 token 位置，纵轴是半事实干预下的概率漂移，画成柱状图。图上叠两条线：一条水平虚线表示 GRPO 给所有 token 的同一优势，一条随漂移增大而下降的实线表示 SCAPO 调整后的优势。柱子越高（越不稳定），实线压得越低。

formulas.name: 半事实稳定性加权的 token 优势 (Semifactual-Stability Reweighted Token Advantage)
formulas.html: A'i,t = Ai · (1 − λ(1 − ŝi,t))+, ŝi,t = norm(1 − |pθ(yt|x) − pθ(yt|x̃)|)
symbols: GRPO 的答案级组相对优势（同一回答内所有 token 共享）
半事实提示：保持底层问题与答案，只改无关措辞
token t 在干预下的概率漂移，越大越不稳定
归一化稳定性，漂移越小越接近 1
早期训练中对不稳定 token 的降权强度
截断到非负：稳定 token 的系数封顶为 1，不获得额外奖励
derivation: GRPO 用组内归一化得到答案级优势 A_i，并把它广播给回答里的每个 token。
若模型依据题面里的无关特征答对，这份虚假依赖也会随 A_i 被一起强化。
构造半事实提示 x̃：问题与答案不变、只改无关措辞，测量每个 token 的概率漂移。
把漂移归一化成稳定性 ŝ，对不稳定 token 按 (1−λ(1−ŝ))_+ 缩放优势；ŝ=1 时系数为 1，不额外加分。
论文另证：解码时抑制高漂移 token 候选即可提升准确率，且无需更新任何权重。
formulas.analogy: 像老师改小组作业：组内总分（答案级优势）平均到每个人头上，但那个只靠抄题面措辞得分的人，这次要单独把他的分数压下来——而不是给「措辞怎么变都不动」的人加分。
pitfalls: 把稳定性当正奖励会鼓励模型输出对所有输入都不敏感的「死板」答案，因此只能降权不能加分。
只在早期训练降权是设计选择：后期不稳定 token 可能正是需要探索的部分。
半事实提示必须保证答案不变，否则测到的是任务难度而不是虚假依赖。
formulas.code:
import torch


def scapo_advantage(grpo_adv, drift, lam=0.5):
    """grpo_adv: [B] 组相对优势; drift: [B, T] 半事实干预下的 token 概率漂移。"""
    stability = 1.0 - drift / (drift.amax(dim=-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-8)   # 归一化
    scale = (1.0 - lam * (1.0 - stability)).clamp(min=0.0)               # 稳定不加分
    return grpo_adv.unsqueeze(-1) * scale

claims: SCAPO 在 Qwen3-4B-Base / Qwen3-1.7B-Base 上分别比 GRPO 提升 AIME 2024-2026 准确率 5.63 / 4.17 个百分点。
抑制高漂移 token 候选可在不更新权重的情况下提升推理准确率。
两个模型规模上，SCAPO 在多数数学基准和全部评测的分布外基准上取得最好结果。
摘要写明代码位于 github.com/DtYXs/SCAPO；该地址未登记在 items/index.json 的 sources 中，仅作线索，需人工核实。
uncertain: 半事实提示如何自动构造（改写模型、模板还是人工）摘要未说明。
归一化稳定性所用 norm 的具体形式与 λ 取值未给出。

items.title: No Task Vector Is an Island: A Comprehensive Study on the Composability of Task Vectors from On-Policy Distillation
items.summary: Task vectors provide a simple mechanism for composing learned capabilities through model merging. However, the composability of task vectors produced by on-policy distillation (OPD) remains largely unexplored. OPD trains a student using teacher feedback on student-generated trajectories, yielding parameter updates that differ from those produced by the teacher model, usually by reinforcement learning (RL). We therefore ask whether OPD task vectors can complement their RL teacher updates and compose effectively across tasks. Across five domains and two model architectures, we find evidence for both forms of composability. Within a task, merging OPD and RL task vectors can outperform both constituent models, even when the OPD student is weaker than its RL teacher. Across tasks, OPD task-vector compositions achieve higher average scores than corresponding RL compositions in seven of eight backbone-merging-rule comparisons. Parameter-space analyses reveal substantial non-collinearity between OPD and RL updates. Experiment in CODE domain on SMOLLM3-3B shows that the combined direction outperforms either constituent direction at the tested global update norm, supporting directional complementarity in this configuration. Across tasks, OPD updates also show lower overlap among the top-10% feed-forward channels ranked by update energy. Together, these results show that weaker standalone performance does not imply weaker task-vector composability. OPD task vectors can complement stronger RL teacher updates and combine effectively across tasks, highlighting composability as a distinct property for understanding and evaluating post-training updates.

concepts.readable: task vector 就是微调后与基座的参数差 τ = θ_ft − θ_base；把它当成一个可加减的方向，多个任务的向量相加就得到多能力模型。

items.title: MeanVoiceFlow2: Joint Optimization of Mean Flow and Content Encoder for Fast One-Step Zero-Shot Voice Conversion
items.summary: Flow-matching approaches to voice conversion (VC) have gained attention owing to their high speech quality and strong speaker similarity. Among them, one-step models such as MeanVoiceFlow are particularly attractive because they enable efficient inference; however, their reliance on a computationally intensive content encoder remains a bottleneck. We therefore propose MeanVoiceFlow2, a framework that jointly optimizes a flow-based conversion module and a computationally efficient content encoder. The model is trained through conversion distillation using MeanVoiceFlow and the reconstruction of real data. We further incorporate diffusion-GAN training with sample mixing and teacher-guided conditioning augmentation to enhance realism and disentanglement. Experiments on zero-shot VC showed that MeanVoiceFlow2 achieved higher perceptual quality and approximately $9\times$ faster inference than MeanVoiceFlow while maintaining comparable speaker similarity. Audio samples are available at https://www.kecl.ntt.co.jp/people/kaneko.takuhiro/projects/meanvoiceflow2/.

concepts.name: 平均速度场一步生成 Mean Flow One-Step Generation
concepts.readable: mean flow 不学每一步的瞬时速度，而是直接学从时刻 t 到终点 1 的平均速度 u(x_t,t)；推理时用起点加一次平均速度就得到结果，所以只需一次前向。
concepts.analogy: 像打车：普通扩散每到一个路口都要重新问一次导航（下一步往哪开），mean flow 直接问「从这里到终点整段路平均往哪开」，一次踩到底就到。
concepts.analogyBreaksDown: 现实里路况固定，所以「平均方向」是个常数；生成任务里平均速度依赖当前所在位置 x_t 和时间区间，位置一变平均方向就变，所以仍要一个网络去预测它，一步近似在分布复杂时会变糙。
concepts.mechanism: 把瞬时速度场沿时间积分得到平均速度场，再用恒等式把它写成数据对差 x_1-x_0 在 x_t 下的条件期望，于是平均速度可以直接用回归目标训练，不需要逐步展开轨迹；代价是要额外估计与瞬时速度/时间导数相关的项，换来的是单次前向推理。

formulas.name: 平均速度场恒等式与一步采样（Mean Flow Identity and One-Step Sampling）
formulas.latex: u(x_t, t) = \mathbb{E}\!\left[\, x_1 - x_0 \mid x_t \,\right], \qquad x_1 \approx x_0 + u(x_0, 0)
symbols: 起点状态（可理解为源语音的内容/声学表示或噪声起点），形状 [B, D] 或 [B, T, D]
终点状态（目标说话人语音表示），与 x_0 同形状
t ∈ [0,1] 处的插值状态，常用线性路径 x_t = (1-t)x_0 + t x_1
从 t 到 1 的平均速度场，由网络预测，形状同 x
在给定 x_t 的条件下对所有数据对 (x_0, x_1) 求期望
derivation: flow matching 用连续归一化流把先验推向数据，轨迹由瞬时速度 v = dx/dt 决定，但采样需要多步数值积分。
为了少步生成，定义从 t 到终点 1 的平均速度 u(x_t,t)，它等于该区间上瞬时速度的平均（对时间做积分再除以 1-t）。
把 u 的定义代入轨迹表达式可得到恒等式 u(x_t,t) = E[x_1 - x_0 | x_t]，于是平均速度能直接用数据对回归训练，无需展开中间步。
推理时取 t = 0，用 x_1 ≈ x_0 + u(x_0, 0) 完成一步生成；训练中还需估计与瞬时速度/时间导数相关的项来正确约束 u（本文具体做法摘要未给出）。
formulas.analogy: 问路而不是自己走：不问每个路口该怎么拐（瞬时速度），而是问「从这儿到终点整体朝哪走」（平均速度），一次就能抵达。
pitfalls: 把 u(x_t,t) 当成瞬时速度 v(x_t,t) 使用，导致采样步数与公式不匹配。
忘记 u 是 t→1 区间上的平均量，t=0 处的一步近似在目标分布复杂时误差最大。
误以为一步生成一定比多步质量差：本文报告感知质量反而更高，但评测设置需回原文确认。
混淆 x_0 与 x_1 的角色（源语音/噪声起点 vs 目标说话人语音），导致重建与蒸馏损失的方向写反。

items.title: QATFactory: A Versatile, Deployment-Aligned Framework for Quantization-aware Training and Distillation of LLMs
items.summary: Large language model (LLM) inference is increasingly moving toward lower precision to realize the throughput of hardware accelerators, but aggressive post-training quantization (PTQ) can degrade model quality. We present QATFactory, an open-source framework for deployment-aligned quantization-aware distillation (QAD) and reinforcement learning (QARL). QATFactory simulates deployment-time quantization while performing matrix multiplications in BF16, allowing models to adapt to quantization noise without requiring training hardware that natively supports the target format; for example, it supports NVFP4 training on H100 GPUs, which lack FP4 Tensor Cores. The framework supports NVFP4, MXFP4, and llama.cpp's Q4_K format; dense and mixture-of-experts models; and both full-parameter and LoRA-based training. It exports checkpoints directly to vLLM and llama.cpp without an additional lossy conversion step or added inference overhead. With QATFactory, we conduct extensive experiments on models ranging from 8B to 230B parameters and evaluate exported checkpoints in production inference engines. Across models and formats, QAD consistently improves deployed-model quality over strong PTQ baselines. On Qwen3.5-9B, QAD achieves average benchmark accuracies of 68.9% under NVFP4 and 66.0% under MXFP4, outperforming the best PTQ results of 65.4% and 56.4%, respectively. Through our experiments, we found that although both FP4 formats quantize weights and activations at deployment, the best training strategy is format-dependent: NVFP4 generally performs better when only weights are quantized during training, whereas MXFP4 benefits from quantizing both weights and activations. formulas.name: 分块伪量化与直通梯度（Block-wise Fake Quantization）
symbols: 第 b 个量化块（如 16 或 32 个元素）
目标格式可表示的最大幅值
反量化后的权重（前向实际使用）
反向用直通估计器，把 round/clip 当恒等映射
derivation: 按块取最大绝对值，定出该块能表示的最大幅值对应的缩放因子 Δ_b。
把权重除以 Δ_b 后四舍五入到整数格点，得到低位宽表示。
裁剪到目标格式范围，再乘回 Δ_b 得到反量化权重。
反向传播时对 round 与 clip 采用直通估计器，让梯度近似无损地穿过去。
formulas.analogy: 像用有限档位的台阶去近似一条连续曲线，台阶高度由这一段的最大值决定。
pitfalls: 块越大，离群值越容易主导 Δ，其它元素分辨率被牺牲。
只量化权重与同时量化激活的噪声量级不同，不能用同一配方。
反量化后必须保持高精度累加，否则误差会在矩阵乘里被放大。
formulas.code:
import torch

def fake_quant_blockwise(w, q_max=6.0, block=32):
    # NVFP4 的 E2M1 可表示范围约为 [-6, 6]
    shape = w.shape
    wb = w.reshape(-1, block)
    delta = wb.abs().amax(dim=1, keepdim=True).clamp(min=1e-8) / q_max
    q = torch.round(wb / delta).clamp(-q_max, q_max)
    dq = (q * delta).reshape(shape)
    # straight-through estimator: 前向用量化值, 反向梯度直通
    return w + (dq - w).detach()

items.title: Label-free steering: Compressing test-time reinforcement learning into bias-only subspaces
items.summary: Test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) enables models to improve their reasoning without relying on labeled training data, but existing approaches typically optimize a large fraction of the model parameters. This raises a natural question: can effective test-time adaptation emerge when both the reward signal and the optimization space are severely restricted? We answer this question with label-free bias-only TTRL, which uses majority-vote pseudolabels as rewards and optimizes only ~100K bias parameters while keeping the pretrained backbone frozen. On MATH-500, our approach reaches 76.67% accuracy with Qwen2.5-7B, slightly exceeding our own labeled bias-steering reproduction while optimizing 76,000x fewer parameters than full-parameter TTRL. The same training procedure improves performance across vision-language and audio reasoning tasks, including MathVista, AI2D, LogicVista, and MMAU. We further show that the learned steering vectors transfer to 4,500 held-out MATH problems, indicating that the adaptation is not limited to the problems used during test-time optimization. Finally, we analyze why this highly restricted adaptation can work, showing that majority-vote reliability improves with rollout consensus and that bias subspaces with greater accessible gradient energy exhibit stronger downstream trainability. These results demonstrate that substantial test-time adaptation can emerge from optimizing a tiny bias-only subspace using entirely label-free rewards.

concepts.name: Bias-only Subspace Tuning（只调偏置子空间）
concepts.readable: 把可训练参数限制在各层的 bias 项（约 10 万个），主干权重全部冻结，用极小的优化空间换取测试时的稳定适应。
concepts.analogy: 像不改造整台机器，只微调所有的对零旋钮来改变输出。
concepts.analogyBreaksDown: 偏置只能整体平移激活，表达不了需要重新组合特征的任务；任务若要求新的特征方向，这个子空间就不够用。
concepts.mechanism: 冻结主干只训 bias，等价于在激活空间上学一组可加性的平移/缩放（steering vector），参数极少、几乎不会灾难性遗忘。
concepts.visual: 每层画成一条水平线，线上只有一个小滑块（bias）可以移动，权重方块都是灰色锁定的。

concepts.name: Majority-vote Pseudo-label Reward（多数投票伪标签奖励）
concepts.readable: 对同一道题采样多条推理链，把出现次数最多的答案当成伪标签，用它构造奖励信号，不需要任何人工标注。
concepts.analogy: 像一群学生独立做题后对答案，票数最多的那个当标准答案，再用它互相批改。
concepts.analogyBreaksDown: 题目太难时多数票本身就错，奖励会把模型往错误方向推：一致性高不等于正确。
concepts.mechanism: 采样 rollout、抽取最终答案、按票数取众数作为伪标签，再用「是否与伪标签一致」构造 0/1 奖励，只在 bias 子空间上做策略优化。

derivation: 对同一问题采样 K 条推理链，各自抽取最终答案。
统计每个答案的票数，取众数作为伪标签 ŷ。
把「答案与伪标签一致」定义为奖励 1，否则 0，完全不需要人工标签。
在 bias-only 子空间上做策略梯度更新，主干参数保持冻结。
formulas.analogy: 像无标准答案的竞赛用「群体投票」当参考答案，再按是否与参考答案一致给分。
pitfalls: K 太小时众数不稳定，奖励噪声会主导更新。
伪标签本身可能全票错误，需要一致性筛选或置信度门槛。
只在 bias 空间优化，限制了模型能修正的错误类型。
formulas.code:
import torch
from collections import Counter

def majority_reward(answers):
    # answers: list[str] 同一题 K 条链抽取出的答案
    label, _ = Counter(answers).most_common(1)[0]
    return [1.0 if a == label else 0.0 for a in answers], label


def bias_only_params(model):
    # 只把 bias 交给优化器, 主干冻结
    for n, p in model.named_parameters():
        p.requires_grad = n.endswith("bias")
    return [p for p in model.parameters() if p.requires_grad]


def reinforce_step(model, batch, rewards, optimizer, logps):
    # logps: (K,) 每条链的对数概率之和; rewards: (K,)
    adv = torch.tensor(rewards) - sum(rewards) / len(rewards)
    loss = -(adv * logps).mean()
    optimizer.zero_grad(); loss.backward(); optimizer.step()
    return loss.item()
